senses.definition: A guide that compares a distance on a map with a distance on the ground.
senses.example: The map scale shows that one mark on the ruler stands for one mile.

senses.definition: The part of a map that explains what the colors, lines, and pictures on it stand for.
senses.example: We checked the map legend to learn which blue line showed a stream.

senses.definition: A map that shows the shapes and heights of the land, along with places and features on it.
senses.example: The walkers used a topographic map to find the steepest hill.

senses.definition: A line on a map that joins places at the same height.
senses.example: One contour line curved all the way around the hill.

senses.definition: An area whose clocks follow the same rules for local time.
senses.example: The town across the border was in a different time zone.

senses.definition: A line of high ground that separates areas where water flows toward different streams, lakes, or other places.
senses.example: Rain ran toward different creeks on the two sides of the drainage divide.

senses.definition: The next best choice you miss because you choose something else.
senses.example: My opportunity cost of choosing a train ride was missing the boat tour.

senses.definition: A record of money a person or group keeps at a bank.
senses.example: We checked how much money was in the bank account before paying the bill.

senses.definition: A bank account meant for keeping money to use later.
senses.example: She put money from her yard sale into a savings account.

senses.definition: Work or help provided for people by a government or another group acting for it.
senses.example: Fire protection is a public service our town helps pay for.

senses.definition: A story, song, saying, or other practice passed on by speaking, singing, or listening.
senses.example: Grandma learned the song from her parents as part of her family’s oral tradition.

senses.definition: Skills, knowledge, and practices that people learn from earlier generations and keep using.
senses.example: Teaching the next group of dancers kept the village’s living heritage going.
